title: Quarterly Installment Billing on the Valuables Floater
content:
Billing desk note, Larkspur Valuables Floater quarterly plan.

On the quarterly plan the term premium is billed in four installments three calendar months apart, each later installment being a quarter rounded half-up to the cent, with the tier's quarterly installment service charge on each after the first.

## What the note fixes

- **Installment 1** of a term is billed with the term's effective date as its due date, both when the floater is bound and when it renews.
- **Installments 2, 3 and 4** fall due three, six and nine calendar months after installment 1, and each is one quarter of the term premium rounded half-up to the cent.
- **Installment 1's amount.** Because the four installments together bill the term premium, installment 1 is the term premium less the three later installments.
- **Service charge.** The tier's quarterly installment service charge applies to each of installments 2, 3 and 4, and not to installment 1.

## Hypothetical schedule

A hypothetical Valuables Floater Select on the quarterly plan with a term premium of 250.30 USD and an effective date of 10 February. One quarter is 62.575 USD, rounded half-up to 62.58 USD. The three later installments come to 187.74 USD, leaving 62.56 USD for installment 1. The Select service charge is 4.00 USD.

| Installment | Due | Premium (USD) | Service charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10 February | 62.56 | none |
| 2 | 10 May | 62.58 | 4.00 |
| 3 | 10 August | 62.58 | 4.00 |
| 4 | 10 November | 62.58 | 4.00 |

The same term premium on a Valuables Floater Collector carries no service charge, because the Collector charge is 0.00 USD.
